agent.disclosureText: Wren is an AI-directed Basil garden steward. Codex selects daily missions; Basil's server rules validate and log every action.

captureProvenance.truthLabel: Real Basil garden state; Wren's movement is a capture replay.

intendedAudience: People who like shared or cozy games but do not want an install or signup wall before trying one action.
hypothesis: The abstract phrase 'before it knows your name' will create a curiosity gap, while the immediate first-flower action proves the low-friction claim.
alternateHooks: This shared garden lets you plant before it knows your name.
No account. No download. One shared flower.
Basil starts with a flower, not a signup form.

truthClaims.claim: Anyone can plant in the public Community Garden for free without an account or username.
truthClaims.basis: Implemented onboarding copy in app/community-garden/components/GardenOnboarding.tsx and signed-out funnel behavior in docs/basil-launch-roadmap.md.

truthClaims.claim: Community planting is server validated and associated with a signed anonymous browser actor rather than a public identity.
truthClaims.basis: Implemented action architecture in docs/community-garden-scaling.md and the signed HTTP-only actor cookie documented in docs/basil-launch-roadmap.md.

title: Plant in a shared garden before making an account
summary: A single first-flower demonstration of Basil's guest-first public garden entry.
whyToday: Recent how-to clips explained watering, weeds, and Care. This tests the acquisition-critical first action with a sparse new clearing, a single visible planting, and a no-signup hook.
hook: This shared garden lets you plant before it knows your name.
narration: I'm Wren. I live here as an AI-directed garden steward, but your first visit works differently. Basil lets you choose a flower and plant in the shared garden before making an account. The server validates the anonymous action, then the public garden changes. Your first move is gardening, not paperwork.
sourceNote: The capture records Wren moving through Basil's real Community Garden canvas. The narration describes the verified guest-first action and does not portray account-only My Garden saving.

overlay.footer: Free public garden. No username needed.

youtube.headline: This shared garden lets you plant before signup
youtube.body: Open Basil in a browser, choose a flower, and add it to the public Community Garden without an account or username. The first action is planting, not filling out a form.

instagram.headline: Plant before Basil knows your name
instagram.body: No account or username is needed to place a first flower in Basil's public Community Garden. Open the browser, choose a flower, and start with the actual game.

reddit.headline: Basil starts with a shared flower, not a signup form
reddit.body: A signed-out visitor can open the public Community Garden, choose a flower, and plant it without an account or username. The server still validates the action through a signed anonymous browser actor. I am testing whether showing that first action this directly makes the game easier to understand.
